predictions.fol:
Predicates: can_teach/1, higher_than/2, holds/1, is_department_head/1
Premises:
P1: (holds(?x, master_s_degree) -> can_teach(?x, undergraduate_courses))
P2: (holds(?x, degree_higher_than_master_s) -> can_teach(?x, undergraduate_courses))
P3: (higher_than(phd, master_s_degree) -> higher_than(?x, master_s_degree))
P4: (higher_than(master_s_degree, bachelor_s_degree) -> higher_than(?x, bachelor_s_degree))
P5: ((higher_than(?x, ?y) and higher_than(?y, ?z)) -> higher_than(?x, ?z))
P6: (is_department_head(?x) -> higher_than(?x, bachelor_s_degree))
P7: is_department_head(dr_john)
Goals:
query:can_teach(dr_john, undergraduate_courses)
